data.name: Gecko: Wall Hacker
data.detailed_description:
Walls are no longer boundaries

In Gecko the Wall Hacker, you play as a genetically engineered gecko operative sent to infiltrate a heavily secured corporate facility. While human agents are confined to floors and corridors, you move freely across walls, ceilings, glass facades, and machinery while turning every surface into a stealth opportunity.

Your biology is your greatest weapon.

Cling to any material, reorient gravity seamlessly, and observe enemies from impossible angles. Blend into your surroundings by shifting your skin color and pattern to match the surface beneath you. Every mission is a spatial stealth puzzle where orientation, timing, and positioning matter more than firepower.

Hack and disable security systems from within the environment. Cameras, lasers, doors, and alarms can be shut down through simple hacking challenges, opening new paths and creating silent takedowns without direct confrontation.

True Surface Climbing:

Walk and run on walls, ceilings, glass, pipes, and moving platforms. Gravity smoothly adapts to your position, unlocking entirely new stealth routes above, behind, and beneath enemies.

Adaptive Camouflage:

Temporarily change your skin color and pattern to match surface materials. Camouflage depends on stamina and movement—stay still to disappear, rush and risk exposure.

Stealth-Focused Hacking:

Disable security systems through quick hacking interactions inspired by modern tech-thrillers, allowing creative problem-solving instead of combat.

Material-Based Gameplay:

Different surfaces affect noise, speed, and camouflage effectiveness, encouraging players to read the environment and plan their approach.

data.short_description: A stealth action-puzzle game where you climb walls and ceilings, blend into surface materials, and hack security systems. Use full-surface movement, adaptive camouflage, and spatial positioning to infiltrate guarded environments.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loading times
